one_line_description: Linear is a project management tool that provides a GraphQL API and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for integrating with AI agents.
auth_notes: Linear supports OAuth 2.0 and personal API keys for authentication.

api_surface.rate_limits: 10,000-point complexity ceiling for all GraphQL API requests

evidence.quote_snippet: Linear’s public API is built using GraphQL. It’s the same API we use internally for developing our applications.
Linear is free up to 250 issues, then $10 (Basic) or $16 (Business) a user a month billed annually.
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides tools for interacting with Linear’s API, enabling AI agents to manage issues, projects, and teams programmatically through the Linear platform.
A server that integrates Linear’s project management system with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to allow LLMs to interact with Linear.
